_instructions: This is the master index of every lesson and topic. Use 'reference <chapter> <topic>' to ask me to explain anything from any lesson, connected to the current lesson.

topics.nodejs: Node.js installation and verification (node -v). Gives us a mini computer program runner so our website can do things. (tags: node, javascript, runtime)
topics.npm: npm = the robot that fetches extra LEGO pieces (packages). Comes with Node.js. (tags: node, packages, install)
topics.vscode: Visual Studio Code = the notebook where we write all our code. (tags: editor, code, terminal)
topics.git: Git = the magic undo button that remembers every version of our work. (tags: version, history, undo)
topics.github: GitHub account = Google Drive for code, helps show work to others.
topics.terminal: Terminal = text box for giving the computer commands.
topics.port: Port = a number that says 'this website lives here' (apartment number).
topics.server: Server = a computer or program that sends and receives data.
topics.setup: Setup guide covering tools, communication commands, and confirmation workflow before starting the journey.
topics.typescript: TypeScript = JavaScript with type safety. Catches bugs before runtime. (tags: typescript, types)
topics.react: React = library for building interactive UIs. Lets us make reusable components. (tags: javascript, frontend)
topics.node-express: Node.js + Express = backend server that runs JavaScript outside the browser. (tags: backend, server)
topics.postgresql: PostgreSQL = relational database with SQL. Stores user data, posts, etc. (tags: database, sql)
topics.docker: Docker = packages the app + its environment so it runs anywhere. (tags: devops, deployment)
topics.expo: Expo = tool to turn React into a mobile app (iOS/Android). (tags: mobile, react-native)
topics.testing: Testing (Vitest/Jest) = automated checks that our code works. (tags: quality, bug-catching)
topics.ci-cd: GitHub Actions = automatically run tests and deploy on every push. (tags: automation, deploy)

topics.html: HTML = Hyper Text Markup Language. The skeleton of a webpage. Says WHAT is on the page.
topics.css: CSS = Cascading Style Sheets. The clothes of a webpage. Says HOW it looks.
topics.tags:
HTML tags like

,

, ,
topics.doctype: <!DOCTYPE html> tells the browser this is HTML5.
topics.viewport: <meta name='viewport'> makes the page shrink properly on phones.
topics.class: class = a label we use in CSS to style a box.
topics.flex: display: flex = arrange boxes in a row (like arranging toys).
topics.grid: display: grid = arrange boxes in rows AND columns (like a chessboard).
topics.media: @media (max-width: 600px) = rules that only apply when the screen is smaller than 600px.
topics.responsive: Responsive design = the page adapts to mobile width.
topics.landing: Landing page = the first page visitors see, designed to get them to sign up.
topics.card_grid: A grid of cards showing features (Live Updates, Trusted Sitters, Pay Simple).
topics.navbar: Navigation bar at the top with logo and links.
topics.hero: The big banner section with a headline, description, and call-to-action button.
